answer: As the tide rises in a delta, agents bid to move basalt from a warehouse. Give each inspected cargo lot one signed warehouse receipt in a shared registry. A sale atomically locks that receipt; delivery retires it, and splitting a lot consumes the parent receipt before creating children with the same total weight. Aliases cannot present copies of one receipt as separate inventory or sell the same load twice. This blocks Sybil inventory inflation if warehouses verify custody and all buyers check the registry; dishonest warehouses remain a risk.
